name: PermitoAI
subtitle: AI Safety and Compliance Agent
description: AI-powered Electronic Permit-to-Work (ePTW) system for Nigerian oil and gas operations. Features include multi-agent risk assessment, compliance checking, SIMOP (simultaneous operations) management, predictive scheduling, hazard suggestion, and intelligent routing for safety-critical workflows.

name: PharmAssist
subtitle: AI Pharmacy Agent
description: AI-powered pharmaceutical search agent built for MedPlus. Leverages embeddings and vector search to deliver intelligent drug information retrieval and pharmaceutical query resolution for users and pharmacy staff.
